mapper.select: SELECT d.id as dialog_id, d.user_id, d.status, d.created_time, d.title, m.id as last_message_id, m.content as last_message_content, m.send_time as last_message_send_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assistant_message WHERE m.dialog_id = d.id) as message_count FROM assistant_dialog d LEFT JOIN assistant_message m ON m.id = ( SELECT id FROM assistant_message WHERE dialog_id = d.id ORDER BY send_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY d.created_time DESC
SELECT user_id FROM assistant_dialog WHERE id = #{dialogId}
